Went there on a weekday evening. After 3-4 days of trying local Vietnamese cuisine, my friend and I wanted to take a break and try something different (Thai in this case). However, having been exposed to a good amount of Thai food in Thailand itself (as well in Mumbai where I reside), the food at Gusto Thai was not great.

Good food but service patchy
Nov 2019
Went there because near to Sofitel and fraction of the price of their Asian restaurant.
Wide choice of typical Thai food and you specify spiciness. Mainly tourist customers.
Staff took order for starters and main courses but delivered in random order.food fine but tepid. May have got something we did not order but staff did not have enough English to discuss!
Left alone by staff who did not seem to want to interact so no second drinks coffee or dessert. Bill adds on 5% service and 5% vat. Looked ok and a generous meal for 2 came to about £25. As the main customers are tourists they really should get more training in English which is the most common second language. This was okay as far as the food was concerned but service was lacking and shoddy.

reviews.review_text:
Mit_besten_Absichten
Laoag, Philippines495 contributions

No authentic thai cuisine
Sep 2018 • Friends
I visited the restaurant on a Friday night after the restaurant was recommended by a friend.
Good location and easy accessible in the city, the restaurant looked clean and well managed, greeted in english on arrival which is not common in the city.
Staff been very friendly and courteous with limited english abilities.
The menu selection is huge, however many items listed are a different composition with other meats. Noticeable that some of the classic items you would expect are not present on the english menu such as Tom ka Gai , Tom Yum or Pad Thai.

Service was good and in a timely manner, food quality was a bit like hit and miss. All items tasted missed a bit of the real thai flavour.
For example the green Papaya salad with dried shrimps and peanuts, normally one of many favourits, came sweet and very spicy, with no zesty lime taste, the sate variation, tasty tender beef saty just spicy without flavour, not sure what the sweet dipping sauce was based on.
The red duck curry servered with bones and very fatty on 4 small pieces of Duck. Stir-fried Chicken with fried morning glory, came mince and oily.

Overall
Good attentive service, cleand and well layed out restaurant, food is lucking the real thai taste, would I return to the restaurant?, not so sure.

reviews.review_text:
NorthWalesKath
North Wales328 contributions
0
Just .... wrong. Must try harder.
Dec 2017 • Family
Group of 4 we came here for dinner. We were sent up to the first floor. Chairs are noisy on the floor. We were given only two menus between four. I had to go and fetch a wine list myself. The young woman maitre de by the door seemed more interested in her iPad than in us. She did not take a drinks order while we chose our food. We were more than ready to order both drinks and food by the time she came back. She seemed very distracted whilst we ordered 4 dishes. A scale of heat 1-4 was at the front of the menu but appeared nowhere else on the menu. My daughter asked for her dish not spicy (a4). It came with two chopped chilli 🌶 on it ?? No one was asked what level of heat they wanted, one of our party called the waitress back to check that his chicken curry dish would be A1 authentic Thai (spicy) but it was very mild. My order of vegetarian mushroom with glass noodles arrived with his chicken curry. His dish was placed in front of him and was more like a starter portion. The steamed rice he’d asked for to go with it didn’t appear until he’d finished half of it. My dish was left in the middle of the table. It was delicious but whilst the glass noodles and sauce were hot (temperature) the mushrooms and vegetables were stone cold. Strange. My partner’s chicken in gravy with fried noodles contained chicken, fish and no noodles and didn’t appear until we were half way through our other dishes. 
White wine was ordered ... “do you want it cold”? “Er... yes, it’s supposed to be cold!!“ was brought upside down in an ice bucket and then left out of reach unopened on an adjacent table. Luckily it was a screw top so we wiped off the ice water on the neck, opened it and helped ourselves. At no point were we asked if our meals were ok. The cost of the meal was quite high. We are only in Hanoi 4 evenings what a shame one of them was spent here.

Good food
Nov 2017 • Couples
Staying in the Hilton Opera Hotel nearby we found this by accident. It’s only a small place with a couple of tables downstairs and several upstairs. Nothing special but the tables are presented well and everything is very clean.

There is an extensive menu and we both ordered a stir fry dish, one was minced pork and the other chicken and cashew nut. With hindsight we should have ordered a portion of rice to share and will do if we go again. The young lad serving had apparently ordered medium spiced dishes on our behalf which was just right as hot spiced dishes would have been too much. We didn’t have to wait long for our food and both dishes were delicious. We then had one dish of sweetened rice with mango which was lovely and we both had a Thai beer. Our young lad was very friendly and helpful with our menu queries.

We would definitely use this restaurant again.
